foreignObject.div:
guard: lead (shield) foot forward, wide stance, knees soft, blade up
100ms

raise: sink onto the rear foot, the blade goes up in front of the face
70ms

wind-up: over the head and back, the lead foot lifts, shield thrust out
70ms

cocked: wrist bent back, the blade hangs down her back; the rear foot drives her on
80ms

lead foot lands - nailed there from now on; the arm comes over, the blade lags behind it
50ms

the cut (smear): hips ride forward over the planted foot, arm straight, blade catching up
40ms

impact (hit-stop): the wrist snaps - arm and blade one straight line; front knee deep, rear leg long
90ms

follow-through: elbow fully straight, the blade runs on down and through
80ms

hold: arm still straight, stays low for a breath
130ms

push back off the front foot (still planted); the blade comes up
80ms
